fact_english: The Palawan stink badger is not a true badger: it belongs to the skunk family.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang pantot ng Palawan, tinatawag na stink badger, hindi pala badger.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Kamag-anak siya ng skunk. Kaya pala ganoon ang pangalan.

after_text: Uminit ang medalyon ni M, at may tumahol sa loob ng liwanag.
why_here: After 'may tumahol sa loob ng liwanag': who barked is answered right after the break.
